issues: Recognising which specific employee is at the door and logging their name requires identifying individuals (face recognition / person re-identification), which the platform does not support.
The platform can only detect generic visible things (e.g. 'a person is at the door'), not who that person is.
Placeholder spec below assumes a fallback of detecting any person at the door; this does not satisfy the original request.
clarification_questions: Would it be useful instead to detect when any person is present at the door (without identifying them), e.g. to trigger a recording or notification?
summary: Identify which named employee is at the door and log their name (unsupported: requires individual identification).

classes.name: person_at_door
classes.description: Any person visible standing at or passing through the door area, without identity information.

event_rules.description: Placeholder: a person is present at the door (no identity recognition).

visual_conditions: Daytime and night-time lighting at the door
People facing toward and away from the camera
Partial occlusion by the door frame or door itself
Different clothing including coats and hats
test_scenarios: Separate recording session at the door with different people
Recording at a different time of day with changed lighting
Empty door scenes to check false alarms
synthetic_targets: Low-light / night lighting at the door
Rainy-weather clothing such as umbrellas and hoods
prompt: Recognise which employee is at the door and log their name
